name: std::iswcntrl
intro:
Checks if the given wide character is a control character, i.e. codes 0x00-0x1F and 0x7F and any control characters specific to the current locale.

If the value of ch is neither representable as a wchar_t nor equal to the value of the macro WEOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the wide character is a control character, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ISO 30112 defines POSIX control characters as Unicode characters U+0000..U+001F, U+007F..U+009F, U+2028, and U+2029 (Unicode classes Cc, Zl, and Zp).

examples.output:
in the default locale, iswcntrl(0x2028) = false
in Unicode locale, iswcntrl(0x2028) = true
